info.title: SafeSign
info.description: Cross-platform code signing command line for Windows executables, installers, packages and scripts, with cloud and HSM key providers including Certum SimplySign.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Cross-platform code signing tool for executables, installers, packages, and scripts.

commands.name: sign
commands.description: Sign one or more files using the specified signing provider.

options.name: --provider
options.description: The signing provider name (run 'safesign providers' to list).

options.name: --output
options.description: Optional output file path when signing a single input file (defaults to in-place).

options.name: --hash
options.description: File digest: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512. [default: SHA256]

options.name: --timestamp-hash
options.description: RFC 3161 digest: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512. [default: SHA256]

options.name: --description
options.description: Optional program name embedded in Authenticode signatures.

options.name: --description-url
options.description: Optional 'more information' URL embedded in Authenticode signatures.

options.name: --skip-package-contents
options.description: Sign only the package, leaving the DLLs and EXEs inside .nupkg files unsigned. [default: False]

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: One or more files to sign.

commands.name: providers
commands.description: List all supported and planned signing providers.

commands.name: formats
commands.description: List all supported and out-of-scope file formats.
